note: golden_hash filled by `node golden-parity.test.mjs --update`. Vectors cover: an exact European whole-fund match against the GP report, a deliberate GP overstatement of its own catch-up share (DIVERGES), and a missing-GP-report case (INDETERMINATE) under the American deal-by-deal tier structure.

vectors.name: european-whole-fund-matches-gp-report
vectors.description: Standard 4-tier European whole-fund waterfall, 8% simple pref, full GP catch-up, 20% carry -- recomputed allocation lands exactly on the GP-reported figures.

clawback.note: Aggregate check only: does cumulative GP catch-up + carry exceed carry_pct of cumulative realized profit (distributions minus contributions) at this as-of date. Not a fund-level clawback provision recompute -- the governing LPA clawback mechanics (interim vs final, tax-effected or gross, escrow terms) are not modeled here.

not_proven.detail: Every dated cashflow is caller-supplied and asserted. This kernel performs no document parsing or fund-administrator data lookups (zero-egress) and does not verify these values against any external source.

This kernel recomputes arithmetic under a DECLARED waterfall parameterization; it makes no finding on whether that parameterization is what the governing limited partnership agreement actually specifies.

ILPA reporting-template guidance is cited only as dated context that GP-side verification tooling is not designed to check the GP's own math. This kernel is not endorsed by, and makes no claim of compliance with, ILPA.
The GP-reported allocation compared against is exactly what the caller typed in; this kernel does not verify it was transcribed correctly from the GP's capital account statement.

output_payload.fence: Cashflows and the waterfall parameterization are SUPPLIED, asserted, and digested into this receipt. This kernel recomputes ARITHMETIC over declared inputs and attests THAT -- never an opinion on LPA authorization, never ILPA-endorsed or ILPA-compliant.
output_payload.ilpa_context: ILPA reporting-template guidance states it was not designed for verifying any of the GP's calculations (cited as dated gap evidence, not as an endorsement of this tool).

vectors.name: european-whole-fund-diverges-gp-overstates-catchup
vectors.description: Same cashflows and terms as the matches vector, but the GP-reported catch-up tier overstates the GP share by $15,000 (offset from carry_residual) -- recompute flags DIVERGES with a per-tier delta.
